Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Customer Data Leaked by Hackers

The incident involved data belonging to thousands of customers, but it isn’t disrupting payment services or connected to banking issues earlier this week

By

and

Data from thousands of customers of Visa V -3.12 % decrease; down pointing triangle, Mastercard MA -2.62 % decrease; down pointing triangle and JPMorgan JPM -1.20 % decrease; down pointing triangle Chase was leaked Thursday by a ransomware group, the latest in a string of tech incidents that have unnerved consumers in the last week.

The hackers gained access to third-party entities and exposed customers’ information, but weren’t disrupting services, the firms said.
